The San Francisco-based company is reallocating resources to aggressively pursue high-margin enterprise clients and intensify competition with rival Anthropic. items.title: 他用WPS笔记，把AI报错变成了可复用的“避坑指南”
items.raw_excerpt: “AI Coding 最大的风险不是写不出代码，而是忘记了自己为什么做出某个判断。” 这不是一句抽象判断，而是工程师曹健在反复处理 AI 报错后得到的真实体会。6月5日，在金山办公旗下「WPS AI Next」活动现场，他从自己的 AI Coding 工作流讲起，分享了使用 WPS 笔记沉淀技术经验的故事。 当天发布的 WPS 笔记，是一款面向个人知识管理场景的 AI 原生多模态笔记产品，主张“随心记录，轻松有序”。对曹健来说，这句话并不抽象。它对应的是一次半夜两点的报错、一套 47 万字的资料库，以及一次从 30 分钟到 3 分钟的排查效率变化。 那次GPU飙到100%后，他多年的积累没能帮到他 2025年的某天凌晨两点，曹健的笔记本电脑GPU占用率飙到100%，屏幕彻底卡死。他自己部署的语音模型，因为一个AI报错整晚停摆，而比这更让他崩溃的是，他隐约记得自己解决过类似的问题，但不记得那条解决记录被放在了哪里。 作为一家外企的技术支持人员，曹健平时既要跟踪用户反馈，又要记录软件更新，还要跑AI辅助写代码。他积累了一个47万字的文档资料库，但那个凌晨，多年的资料并没有帮他定位问题。 此前，他试过市面上几乎所有笔记工具，但复杂的产品设计常常让他望而却步。“打开就得做规划、选知识库、找位置、建分类，然后才是生成文档，像是要让你写本书”，曹健说，繁复的设置和交互摩擦，总让他有卸载的冲动。 一次偶然的机会，他在小红书刷到了WPS笔记内测招募的帖子。获得内测资格后，他打开产品界面，发现屏幕中间只有两个按钮。“当时我愣了一下，”他回忆道，“产品做得‘很轻’，像是有人终于想明白了怎么记笔记这件事。” “同类AI报错排查从30分钟降到了3分钟” 曹健每天要处理海量信息，但不是所有内容都得单独建一篇文档。“大多时候，我只想先把它们放在某个地方，再集中整理。” WPS笔记刚好对上了他的需求。“

excerpt_i18n.en: In the first half of this year, external observers often found Huawei Cloud's AI strategy somewhat ambiguous. Over the past six months, cloud vendors' AI narratives have become increasingly specific: Alibaba Cloud and Volcano Engine are both emphasizing model call volumes and MaaS revenue, while Tencent Cloud is currently focusing on blockbuster applications. In contrast, it was previously unclear to outsiders where Huawei Cloud intended to position its core role in the AI era. This time, the Huawei Cloud INSPIRE Conference provided a good window for observation. From this conference, Huawei Cloud is articulating its position more clearly: downward, it aims to be the "silicon-based black soil" of the intelligent agent era; upward, it seeks AI commercialization outlets in industry scenarios such as healthcare, embodied intelligence, manufacturing, and scientific research. Huawei Cloud does not want to be defined solely by MaaS. During a media group interview at the event, Leiphone posed a direct question to Huawei Cloud's CEO: In the first half of this year, Alibaba Cloud and Volcano Engine have been pushing for MaaS revenue. How does Huawei Cloud view MaaS revenue? And does it have specific revenue targets for this year? This question is actually quite critical. In the past general computing era, cloud vendors primarily focused on infrastructure revenue: CPU cores, storage, bandwidth, and resource consumption. In the intelligent computing era, the industry has entered a token economy, where MaaS revenue, model call volumes, and token consumption are becoming new metrics for measuring AI cloud performance. However, Zhou Yuefeng's response was also straightforward. He stated that Huawei Cloud does not deny the token economy but cannot simply use "how many trillions of tokens"
excerpt_i18n.es: En la primera mitad de este año, la estrategia de Huawei Cloud en IA a menudo parecía difusa para el exterior. En los últimos seis meses, la narrativa de IA de los proveedores de nube se ha vuelto cada vez más concreta: Alibaba Cloud y Volcano Engine hablan sobre el volumen de llamadas de modelos y los ingresos de MaaS, mientras que Tencent Cloud se centra en aplicaciones populares. En contraste, el exterior no siempre tenía claro cuál sería la posición central de Huawei Cloud en la era de la IA. Esta vez, la conferencia Huawei Cloud INSPIRE ha proporcionado una buena ventana de observación. Desde esta conferencia, Huawei Cloud está definiendo más claramente su posición: hacia abajo, busca ser la "tierra negra de silicio" en la era de los agentes inteligentes; hacia arriba, desde la medicina hasta la robótica.

It is not parameters, not monthly active users, not multimodality—it is whether you can excel at coding. Pulling data from four Chinese large model companies, this trend is so clear it doesn’t require statistical testing: DeepSeek, with outstanding coding capabilities, is negotiating a $7 billion single financing round—the largest ever for a domestic AI company—with a potential valuation of $59 billion.
